The '''ikopi''' was a fleet-footed [[ungulate]] with telescopic legs for fast locomotion. They lived in the plains and [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and they traveled in herds.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Ikopi_Wildlife.jpg|thumb|left|Ikopi adult female and her two-month-old calf.]]

Ikopis had short necks, for defensive purposes. They compensated for that with a long, tube-like [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]], roughly two to three times longer than their head, to reach and grasp food far above their reach. The tongue was hollow, which allowed them to suck up [[Water/Legends|water]] below their knees, as well as to drink nectar, like a straw. When not being used, the ikopi's tongue would coil up inside the animal's cheek sack.<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

A tallish mammal with long, telescopic legs for fast locomotion, the ikopi was less a swimmer than a runner and swift forder of swamps. It was most commonly seen in herds prancing across the wetlands.<ref name=":0" /> When threatened, an ikopi was more likely to run than anything else. While their legs can serve them in swimming, they did not take to water easily and prefer to escape over land.<ref name=":1">{{DB|creature|ikopi|ikopi}}</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ikopi design was inspired by a North African/Saharan gazelle, with a few giraffe-like characteristics thrown in.<ref name=":1" />
